name: Cyberion ThreatShield - Phase 6 tested coverage
description: 21 technique IDs scored from recorded replay results, not from intent. Covered 1, Partially Covered 12, Not Covered 8. A Partially Covered entry has a rule that matched real attack telemetry but no measured benign comparison, because the recordings contain no separately collected clean environment. Associated tactics are ATT&CK taxonomy and do not assert that the objective occurred in these captures.

techniques.comment: Not Covered. DS002 records three WMI 5857 provider-start events and one WmiPrvSE.exe process creation, which is provider startup rather than an adversary WMI operation. No rule was written because a WmiPrvSE rule would match ordinary Windows on every host. Minimal new dataset: a WMI-Activity 5858 or 5861 operation record with an attributable process, or a child process created through WMI.

techniques.comment: Not Covered. No registry record in DS002 writes a CurrentVersion\Run or RunOnce target; the reviewed registry events cover Internet Settings, Delivery Optimization and notification keys only. The only 'Startup' text in the capture is unrelated. Minimal new dataset: a Sysmon-instrumented capture with event 13 writes to HKLM\...\CurrentVersion\Run plus the resulting execution of the written value. Minimum acceptance: one labelled run-key write and one process creation whose parent or command line references the written value.
